message: The other day, as I watched the weather forecast hint at a stormy weekend, I realized I was more prepared for a cozy indoor day than I ever thought. I dug out some old board games, the kind that require actual human interaction, and dusted off a few books that had been patiently waiting on the shelf. It was a delightful reminder that when the skies turn gray, sometimes the best plan is to unplug and enjoy a little low-tech fun. Who knew a rainy day could turn into a family game tournament? 🎲
